description:
Tumblr Scraper

Scrape Tumblr posts from any public blog, tag or search query. Full-resolution media, tags, note counts, engagement metrics, reblog info and NSFW classification. No API key, no login needed.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Posts scraped: $0.002; Media file downloaded: $0.005.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/tumblr-scraper.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

blogNames.description: One or more blogs, comma-separated. Accepts a bare name (staff), a host (staff.tumblr.com), a custom domain, or a full URL (https://staff.tumblr.com).
blogNames.title: Blog names (blog mode)

downloadMedia.description: Download images and videos into the run's key-value store and reference them from each row's mediaFiles column. Files over 50 MB and third-party embeds are skipped. Billed per file downloaded.
downloadMedia.title: Download media files

fullResMedia.description: Pick the largest available rendition of every image/video instead of Tumblr's small thumbnail. Uses inline srcset / NPF data where possible, and only falls back to fetching the post page when a post offers nothing better.
fullResMedia.title: Resolve full-resolution media

includeNotes.description: Request note details (notes_info + reblog_info) and emit a notes[] column. Note counts always come back; individual note bodies are NOT returned by Tumblr's keyless endpoints, so notes[] is usually null — see the README.
includeNotes.title: Include notes

includeRaw.description: Keep the untouched Tumblr object in a raw column for full fidelity. Turn off for smaller datasets.
includeRaw.title: Include raw payload

maxPosts.description: Total posts to collect across all targets. Deduplicated by post ID, so overlapping tags/queries never double-count.
maxPosts.title: Max posts

mode.description: blog = posts from one or more blogs (legacy read API first, with an automatic fallback to the blog's SSR page; paginates through the archive). tag = posts from a tag hub page. search = posts matching a search query.
mode.title: Mode

postTypes.description: Keep only these post types. Leave empty for all types. Types are detected by sniffing the actual post media, not by trusting Tumblr's declared type — a 'regular' post with inline photos matches both text and photo.
postTypes.title: Post types

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy settings. Datacenter proxy works for all modes (pagination verified live through it). Set a non-EU country (US) if your exit IP is EU-based (Tumblr's consent wall can gate its JSON API) — or switch to RESIDENTIAL if you see repeated 429s.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

requestDelayMs.description: Hard floor between HTTP requests. Tumblr rate-limits per IP and starts returning 429 after bursts of 3-6 rapid requests, so values under 1000 ms are not recommended.
requestDelayMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)

searchQueries.description: One or more search queries, comma-separated. Pages beyond the first are fetched through Tumblr's web API; from an EU exit IP that API can redirect to a consent wall — see the README.
searchQueries.title: Search queries (search mode)

tags.description: One or more tags, comma-separated. A leading # and a full /tagged/ URL are both accepted. Pages beyond the first are fetched through Tumblr's web API; from an EU exit IP that API can redirect to a consent wall — see the README.
tags.title: Tags (tag mode)
